_comment: Advisories that `npm audit` reports but which are not reachable in this
site. Every entry must carry a justification and an expiry date.
This is NOT a way to defer work on an exploitable finding. An entry is only
legitimate when the vulnerable code path cannot be reached at all. If a fix
exists and is installable, bump the dependency instead.
Entries are checked by .github/scripts/audit-check.mjs. An expired entry is a
hard failure, so every suppression comes back for review on its own.
`workspaces` names the directories an entry was justified for; this repo has
one package, at the root, so it is always ["."].

allow.reason: http-cache-semantics comes in through astro, which uses it only in the build-time loader for remote images. The site has no remote images and no server: it ships static files, so there is no shared cache answering clients for the advisory to apply to. No fixed version exists yet.
